velos.name: Touring bike
velos.alt: Velo de Ville Trekking L200 touring bike for hire in Nantes
velos.title: Touring Bike Hire Nantes from €22/day | Bike'N Tour
velos.meta: Hire a touring bike in Nantes for the Loire à Vélo or La Vélodyssée: rear rack, disc brakes, €22 a day, €110 a week.
velos.lead: Our touring bike is custom-built for cycle touring with our German partner Velo de Ville: sturdy, comfortable and ready to carry two panniers.

specs.label: Drivetrain
specs.valeur: Shimano Cues, single chainring, 9 speeds (11-41 cassette)

specs.label: Equipment
specs.valeur: Rear rack, mudguards, dynamo front and rear lights, ergonomic handlebar, Royal saddle

velos.why: It's our most popular bike for the Loire à Vélo and La Vélodyssée: upright riding position, 9 well-spaced gears and a rear rack that takes two 20-litre Ortlieb panniers.

velos.name: E-bike
velos.alt: Sunn Start S1 e-bike for hire in Nantes

velos.meta: Hire a touring e-bike in Nantes: Bosch motor, 100 km range, rear rack. €35 a day, €172 a week, one-way hire available.
velos.lead: The Sunn touring e-bike, made just a few kilometres from Nantes, with a Bosch motor and a removable battery you can recharge at every stop.

specs.label: Motor
specs.valeur: Bosch Active Line Plus, 400 Wh frame battery

specs.label: Equipment
specs.valeur: Rear rack, mudguards, front and rear lights, charger and battery key

velos.why: Ideal for long stages, couples with different fitness levels and hilly routes like the Brittany Crossing. The battery comes out with the key provided, so you can recharge it where you're staying.

velos.name: Gravel bike
velos.alt: Sunn Venture S1 gravel bike for hire in Nantes

velos.meta: Hire a Sunn gravel bike in Nantes for the Nantes Vineyards, towpaths or bikepacking: Shimano GRX, rear rack. €35 a day.

velos.name: Kids' bike
velos.alt: Kids' bike for hire in Nantes
velos.title: Kids' Bike Hire Nantes from €20/day | Bike'N Tour
velos.meta: Hire a kids' bike (20, 24 or 26 inches) in Nantes for a family Loire à Vélo trip: €20 a day, €88 a week. Baby seat and trailer available.
velos.lead: For family trips: kids' bikes from 20 to 26 inches, plus a baby seat or trailer for the little ones as an extra.
velos.why: On the Loire à Vélo, the traffic-free sections and very flat profile mean children can ride safely. Allow 20 to 30 km a day with children.

accessoires.nom: Pair of waterproof Ortlieb rear panniers (2 × 20 L)
accessoires.description: Two waterproof rear panniers of 20 litres each that clip onto the rear rack: the essential kit for a trip of several days.
A 6-litre bag fixed to the handlebars, to keep your phone, papers, sun cream and snacks within easy reach.
A padded saddle cover for extra comfort on long stages.
A sturdy mount so you can follow the GPX track on your phone without stopping.
An approved baby seat for children aged 1 and over, mounted on the rear rack.
A trailer to carry one or two children aged 1 and over, sheltered from the wind and sun.
An adjustable helmet, recommended for the whole family.

inclus: Bike fitted to your size and route advice
